text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: Just how much chaos does that monster need to cause...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの魔物、
どれだけ暴れ回れば気が済むんだろう。

text_block_list.name: Mio
text_block_list.text:
It's not going down easily.
What a tough cookie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なかなか倒せないね。
しぶといな～！

text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.text:
We're all feeling pretty worn out right now...
But that must go for the monster too, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちも疲れてギリギリな感じですけど……
でも、
それは向こうも同じですよね！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. I feel like it's getting frustrated.
We must almost have it beaten!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
やけくそに暴れてる感じがするし。
もう一押しのはずだよ！

text_block_list.name: Mio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice!
In that case, let's use the last of our strength,
and take it down at full power!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか！
それなら
最後の力を振り絞って
フルパワーでいっちゃうよー！

text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's give it everything we've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！　
私たちの全力で挑みましょう！
